summary: 77-year-old hiker appeared to have fallen somewhere off the Whiteside Trail on Guanella Pass on a Sunday evening; at least five trail bystanders built a makeshift stretcher from belts, shoelaces and tree branches and carried him ~1/2 mile before meeting Platte Canyon Fire firefighters and paramedics, whose call came at 6:13 p.m.; first responders said the bystanders' actions were 'instrumental' in his survival
responding_agency: Platte Canyon Fire Protection District; paramedics; trail bystanders
notes: Unofficial Networks 2021-10-06 report of 9NEWS coverage; incident date = the Sunday before publication (6:13 p.m. Sunday call), weekday-verified; Guanella Pass per Clear Creek DB convention; name unreleased
